answer_A.existing_dispatch_accounting: An activated exact slug may dispatch sequentially only when current settled + reserved/uncertain + next operation maximum <= account limit. Valid supplier ceilings and complete attribution are preconditions for this accounting to bound spend. Settlement overrun is recorded and stops later dispatch; it cannot undo an upstream charge.

pure_local_planning.asr_grouping: One original line WAV per track per uncached clip+hints; no cross-line batching. Each WAV is downsampled to 16kHz mono PCM. A second local transcriber is a separate optional command.
pure_local_planning.audio_jev_grouping: Only text mismatches; at most 40 lines per request across scenes; 143 lines => 0..4 calls/track/pass. Optional second transcripts may add up to 4 further Jev calls per track/pass.

prices_implemented_not_account_invoice.media_success_settlement_note: Image/music ready jobs settle job.usd_estimate from catalogue, not an independently fetched supplier invoice. Speech and judges compute ledger actual from returned token usage and checked-in rates; missing receipt remains uncertain.

illustrative_untruncated_model_cap_arith.interpretation: Sums are planning illustrations of current per-operation maxima before the USD25 stop truncates execution. They are neither expected spend, supplier invoices nor a guarantee of completion. They do not establish a requirement to reserve every future call simultaneously. A sequential run can be admissible after reviewed activation if real settlements leave room for its next reserve.

images_authorized_batch.code_scope: keyframes default 3, CLI accepts 1..6, seed offsets and changed prompts can create new sets. Current authorization remains 3 total/scene; repeated batch/force/prompt-change generation is not implicitly authorized.

narration.conditional_fixed_source_formula: 165*(1+R) TTS and 143*(1+R) ASR where R is an explicitly reviewed whole-track retake-pass allowance; each partial pass is counted from actual affected groups/clips. Optional Jev second transcripts are extra. Source rewrite requires a new reviewed source/quote.

dubs_each_locale.scope: One uninterrupted automation lifecycle for these 143 fixed line IDs and voice partitions, no operator resets, no force, no arbitrary text/layout changes, no newly authorized retries. Initial plus two shortening plus two retake plus two reword passes conservatively allow 7 TTS passes. Shortening runs before a successful check, so at most initial +2 retake +2 reword =5 fresh ASR check passes. Current translations all plan as <=165 TTS dispatches per pass including split fallback; changed text must remain within existing field limits and voice partitions.

dubs_all_eight_selected.text_stage_price_status: API-priced text rejected for pilots (unknown bounded USD). Durable subscription stages are permitted only after activation and selected account/quota verification; this audit does not assume an unknown subscription allocation or supplier fee is zero.

retry_and_completion_limits.uncertain_attempts: Speech journal and ledger preserve lost-answer operations. Pilot speech/judge/media uncertainty holds or blocks; it is not automatically a free retry. Proven unbilled refusals may release and retry. Manual retries/reset/force have no universal film-completion bound.
retry_and_completion_limits.reason: The worker can give up/skipped.json after fitting/hearing failures; metadata/CC/dub selections do not guarantee all selected audio tracks are successfully delivered.

safe_future_test_cases_not_executed: Pure fixtures: long aliases/styles versus 1500 source chars; uncounted prompt overhead; output+thought totals exceeding candidate count; maxOutputTokens absent/ignored/unsupported => retain modelwide cap or hold.

WAV fixtures: exact durations, >75sec, stereo/non-PCM/wrong rate, malformed headers; verify no dispatch on rejected input and bound prompt plus 32 audio tokens/sec under a documented supplier contract.
Planner fixtures: 22 multi-line groups/45 fallback lines; all/partial retakes, changed translation lengths and voice partitions; eight selected locales cannot be silently removed from quote.

Ledger fixtures: concurrent reserves serialize; uncertain operations persist; duplicate IDs do not dispatch; settled usage above quote bound records overrun and blocks; new retry cannot erase old exposure.

Media fixtures: global 3-take allowance survives prompt/seed/force/reset changes, retained music cannot be silently repurchased, reused bookends/local clean/burned exports make no new provider request.
Jev fixtures: 40/41 mismatch batching and optional second-transcript extra questions; subscription/API text stages cannot become unpriced paid work.
